task.description: Design the HTTP handler layer for API-02: Process definition CRUD. Produce a design artefact at src/design/api-02-definition-crud.md covering: (1) all 7 routes (POST /definitions, GET /definitions, GET /definitions/:id, PUT /definitions/:id, PATCH /definitions/:id, DELETE /definitions/:id, POST /definitions/:id/activate), (2) request/response types for each route, (3) HTTP status codes and error cases per the acceptance criteria in API-02, (4) role guard placement (PROCESS_DESIGNER/PLATFORM_ADMIN for write ops, any-auth for reads), (5) integration points with the PD module (store.zig), (6) pagination contract integration per API-06, (7) graph validation trigger points (API-07). Do not write implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: src/design/api-02-definition-crud.md exists and covers all 7 routes
Request and response types defined for each route
HTTP status codes documented for all success and error cases in API-02 acceptance criteria
Integration with store.zig and validation layer documented
Pagination fields (cursor, page_size) described for GET /definitions

result.summary: Design artefact for api-02-definition-crud: all seven API-02 routes designed with full request/response types, HTTP status codes, error taxonomy, role guards, graph validation trigger points, pagination integration, and three open questions flagged for REQ-ANALYST clarification.
